These compounds are all implicated in targeting the Synaptic vesicular amine transporter, indicating a possible functional or biochemical pathway connecting 13-cis-Retinol to this transporter.  The evidence is supported by multiple high-scoring pathways, suggesting a consistent pattern of interaction across different molecular entities.  However, the exact mechanism by which 13-cis-Retinol influences the Synaptic vesicular amine transporter remains unclear, and further experimental validation is needed to establish a direct causal relationship.
